content.text: Seit `v0.2.0` gibt es den Kopier-Icon und ein paar Doku-Änderungen. Das wird `v0.2.1`. Ich gleiche die Versionsdateien an, tagge und pushe das Release.

input.command:
APP_VERSION=0.2.1 ./packaging/set-version.sh && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
files = [
    "build/darwin/Info.plist",
    "build/darwin/Info.dev.plist",
    "build/linux/nfpm/nfpm.yaml",
    "build/windows/info.json",
    "build/windows/nsis/project.nsi",
    "build/windows/nsis/wails_tools.nsh",
]
for name in files:
    path = Path(name)
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    updated = text.replace("0.2.0", "0.2.1")
    if updated == text:
        raise SystemExit(f"no version bump in {name}")
    path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{name} -> 0.2.1")
for name in ["build/windows/msix/app_manifest.xml", "build/windows/msix/template.xml"]:
    path = Path(name)
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    updated = text.replace('Version="0.2.0.0"', 'Version="0.2.1.0"')
    if updated == text:
        raise SystemExit(f"no msix version bump in {name}")
    path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"{name} -> 0.2.1.0")
PY
input.description: Bump product version files to 0.2.1
